original_attribute_definitions.definition: Defines whether the location was one used by the brood (1) or was available to the brood (0) within 2.4 km of the nest where the brood hatched
original_attribute_definitions.name: Used

original_attribute_definitions.definition: For statistical analyses, each data point that represented a real duckling location in a wetland (used location column equals 1) was given a weight of 1 and each available location (used location column equals 0) was given a weight of 1000
original_attribute_definitions.name: Weight

original_attribute_definitions.definition: Unique identifier for each radio-tracked brood
original_attribute_definitions.name: Brood ID

original_attribute_definitions.definition: Unique identifier for each wetland unit
original_attribute_definitions.name: Wetland ID

original_attribute_definitions.definition: Every flooded wetland unit for each year was assigned to one of five wetland types based on the timing of flooding and the duration that water was present in the wetland
original_attribute_definitions.name: Wetland Type

original_attribute_definitions.definition: Each unique wetland unit was assigned to one of six wetland vegetation categories for the entire study period, based on the dominant vegetation within the outer boundary of the flooded area in each wetland
original_attribute_definitions.name: Dominant Veg Category

original_attribute_definitions.definition: The percent of the area within the overall flooded wetland unit boundary that contained emergent vegetation was calculated by taking the sum of all individual polygons within the wetland unit’s boundary (not the flooded wetland boundary for a given year and time period) that were not defined as open water or barren
original_attribute_definitions.name: Percent Veg of Unit

original_attribute_definitions.definition: Salinity concentration of the surface water in each wetland unit for each year and time period
original_attribute_definitions.name: Salinity Concentration

original_attribute_definitions.definition: The flooded area of each wetland unit for each year and time period combination
original_attribute_definitions.name: Wetland Area

original_attribute_definitions.definition: The water map (from Schacter et al. 2021) that was used to determine the flooded wetland area, based on which water map was closest to the hatch date of the radio-tracked brood
original_attribute_definitions.name: Water Map Time Period

original_attribute_definitions.definition: Unique combination of species and study year
original_attribute_definitions.name: Species Year

original_attribute_definitions.definition: Unique identifier for each radio-tracked brood
original_attribute_definitions.name: Brood ID

original_attribute_definitions.definition: The age of the brood (0 is the day the brood hatched)
original_attribute_definitions.name: Duckling Age

original_attribute_definitions.definition: The distance between each brood location in a wetland and the nest where the brood hatched
original_attribute_definitions.name: Distance from Nest
